description: This script sets up and manages a testing environment for Git with SVN integration, including checks for prerequisites, repository creation, server setup, and utility functions for SVN operations.

methods.name: poke
methods.description: Changes the modification time of a file.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Executes an SVN command with optional configuration directory.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server for SVN if environment variable GIT_TEST_SVN_HTTPD is true.

methods.name: convert_to_rev_db
methods.description: Converts raw data into SVN revision database format using Perl script.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Checks if GIT_TEST_SVNSERVE is enabled; skips test if not.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts SVN server on specified port and root directory.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Prepares UTF-8 locale environment for tests.
